section: Mathematics · Ch38 — Methodology of Teaching Mathematics
subject: Mathematics
stem: Students verify the formula for the area of a circle by measuring and calculating the areas of several actual circular objects (like plates and lids) themselves, rather than being told the formula. This hands-on, self-verification approach to mathematics teaching is called the:
explanation: The laboratory method has students perform hands-on measurement and experimentation to discover or confirm mathematical relationships themselves.

subject: Mathematics
stem: A teacher points out that percentages learned in Mathematics are the same concept used to calculate profit/loss in Economics class and to read data in Social Studies graphs. Deliberately connecting mathematics to other school subjects like this is called the principle of:
explanation: The correlation principle links mathematics learning to its application in other subjects and real life.
